# Noto Sans JP

[日本語](README.ja.md)

The variable font Noto Sans JP, from `ofl/notosansjp/` of [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts) as fetched on 2026-11-15 (`source.txt` lists each file with its size and MD5), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`). `METADATA.pb` is the file of the same directory; it names the upstream [notofonts/noto-cjk](https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk) commit.

| File | Upstream name | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `NotoSansJP.ttf` | `NotoSansJP[wght].ttf` | 9 589 900 bytes |

The font is unchanged and programs embed it unchanged; only the name is shortened, since brackets are awkward in CMake paths. Its one axis is `wght` 100 to 900 ([docs/resources.md](../../docs/resources.md)).
